one_liner: A sales pipeline CRM and developer platform offering a comprehensive REST API, webhooks, and OAuth 2.0/API key authentication.
access_notes: API access is included on every paid and trial plan, and developers can sign up for a self-serve trial or create a developer account.
verdict_reason: Pipedrive offers a well-documented REST API, self-serve trial access, standard OAuth 2.0 and API token authentication, and robust developer capabilities.

evidence.snippet: Access to the Pipedrive API is only possible using the API key or an access token when using OAuth 2.0.
14-day free trial, no credit card required
API type | REST over HTTPS, JSON responses, CORS-enabled
Webhooks | Yes, Webhooks v2 with event-based subscriptions across all core entities
Free developer sandbox account, separate from production
A Model Control Protocol (MCP) server implementation for interacting with the Pipedrive CRM API.

agent_notes: Community MCP servers exist on GitHub, and Pipedrive provides extensive REST APIs with API v1 and v2, supported by SDKs and developer docs.
